A2UIAgentCapabilities.description: The server/agent capabilities object, advertised e.g. in an Agent Card.
A2UIAgentCapabilities.title: A2UIAgentCapabilities

A2UIClientAction.description:
A client-reported user action. ``name`` is any non-empty string.

The vendored ``client_to_server.json`` does not forbid extra keys on the
action object, so protocol extensions are tolerated (``extra="allow"``).
A2UIClientAction.title: A2UIClientAction

A2UIClientCapabilities.description: The ``a2uiClientCapabilities`` A2A metadata object a client sends.
A2UIClientCapabilities.title: A2UIClientCapabilities

A2UIClientDataModel.description:
The ``a2uiClientDataModel`` A2A metadata object a client may attach.

``surfaces`` is required (``required: ["version", "surfaces"]`` in the
vendored ``client_data_model.json``) — an empty ``{}`` is a valid value,
but the key must be present.
A2UIClientDataModel.title: A2UIClientDataModel

A2UIClientMessage.description: The client->server envelope: ``version`` plus exactly one of ``action``/``error``.
A2UIClientMessage.title: A2UIClientMessage

A2UIGenericError.description: Any other client-reported error. Tolerates protocol extensions.
A2UIGenericError.title: A2UIGenericError

A2UIMessageBlock.description: Reference to one durable A2UI surface.
A2UIMessageBlock.title: A2UIMessageBlock

A2UIServerMessage.description: The server->client envelope: ``version`` plus exactly one operation.
A2UIServerMessage.title: A2UIServerMessage

A2UIValidationError.description: The client's ``VALIDATION_FAILED`` error report. Strict, closed shape.
A2UIValidationError.title: A2UIValidationError

ActionCardAction.description: One action exposed by an action card.
ActionCardAction.title: ActionCardAction

ActionCardBehavior.description: Registered action-card behavior with forward-compatible parameters.
ActionCardBehavior.title: ActionCardBehavior

AgentRole.description: Whether the agent executed or annotated the transform.
AgentRole.title: AgentRole

ArtifactKind.description: The curated kinds an artifact version may take.
ArtifactKind.title: ArtifactKind

ArtifactRecord.description: A mutable logical artifact chain keyed by workspace and name.
ArtifactRecord.title: ArtifactRecord

ArtifactVersion.description: One immutable version of a logical artifact.
ArtifactVersion.title: ArtifactVersion

CatalogFile.description: One official-shape A2UI catalog document (a ``catalog.json`` file).
CatalogFile.title: CatalogFile

CatalogSidecar.description: CLIO packaging metadata for one catalog. Never sent on the A2UI wire.
CatalogSidecar.title: CatalogSidecar

CreateSurfacePayload.description: ``createSurface``: begin rendering a new surface against one catalog.
CreateSurfacePayload.title: CreateSurfacePayload

Custody.description: Where artifact bytes live and what custody guarantee applies.
Custody.title: Custody

EdgeEvidence.description: How a provenance edge's identity is known.
EdgeEvidence.title: EdgeEvidence

EdgeRole.description: Which side of a transform a provenance edge sits on.
EdgeRole.title: EdgeRole

EnvironmentRecord.description: Nested schema for a transform's non-secret execution environment.
EnvironmentRecord.title: EnvironmentRecord

EnvironmentTier.description: How precisely an execution environment is pinned.
EnvironmentTier.title: EnvironmentTier

EvidenceClass.description: How an artifact version's identity is known.
EvidenceClass.title: EvidenceClass

FunctionDefinition.description:
Interface metadata for one function in an *inline* catalog.

Matches ``client_capabilities.json#/$defs/FunctionDefinition`` verbatim.
Not used by :class:`CatalogFile` — see the module docstring.
FunctionDefinition.title: FunctionDefinition

IdentityEvidence.description: The evidence basis on which an artifact's content is pinned.
IdentityEvidence.title: IdentityEvidence

InlineCatalog.description:
One inline catalog a client bundles into its declared capabilities.

Matches ``client_capabilities.json#/$defs/Catalog``. Only sent when the
server declares ``acceptsInlineCatalogs: true``.
InlineCatalog.title: InlineCatalog

Instrument.description: The tool or script that produced a transform.
Instrument.title: Instrument

MessageBlock.description: Closed discriminated union of the 13 GACT 0.3 message-block types.
MessageBlock.title: MessageBlock

PlanMessageBlock.description: Plan content emitted in causal order.
PlanMessageBlock.title: PlanMessageBlock

ProvEdge.description: One used or generated provenance edge with its own evidence.
ProvEdge.title: ProvEdge

ReasoningMessageBlock.description: Provider reasoning or semantic next-thought narration.
ReasoningMessageBlock.title: ReasoningMessageBlock

ReplayContract.description: The permanent replay guarantee stamped on a transform.
ReplayContract.title: ReplayContract

RoutingMessageBlock.description: Routing or compaction metadata visible to the user.
RoutingMessageBlock.title: RoutingMessageBlock

TransformKind.description: Whether provenance was observed under exclusive or contended custody.
TransformKind.title: TransformKind

TransformRecord.description: One coarse transform keyed by the observer call id.
TransformRecord.title: TransformRecord

UpdateComponentsPayload.description:
``updateComponents``: replace a surface's component tree.

Component shape is validated separately, against the surface's catalog
(:func:`clio_schemas.a2ui.validation.catalog_validators`) — not here.
UpdateComponentsPayload.title: UpdateComponentsPayload

UpdateDataModelPayload.description:
``updateDataModel``: set or delete one path in a surface's data model.

Per the vendored schema, an *omitted* ``value`` deletes the key at
``path``; a present ``value`` (including an explicit ``null``) replaces
it. :attr:`value_provided` distinguishes the two cases.
UpdateDataModelPayload.title: UpdateDataModelPayload

_EventRoute.description: Where one client action name routes, beyond the default agent lane.
_EventRoute.title: _EventRoute

_Implementation.description: Which renderer kernel implements one catalog component.
_Implementation.title: _Implementation

_Trust.description: Where a catalog came from, for permission/provenance gating.
_Trust.title: _Trust

description: Aggregate of all canonical clio-schemas records with shared definitions emitted once. Used to generate TypeScript without duplicate declarations.
title: ClioSchemaRegistry
